questions.title: 01 Read coefficients and constants
questions.objective: Identify the coefficient, added constant and right-hand side.
questions.prerequisites: Read signed integers and multiplication by a variable.

questions.title: 02 Complete a balanced calculation
questions.objective: Complete the right-hand side after removing the added constant.

questions.title: 03 Choose the cancelling move
questions.objective: Remove the added constant while preserving the coefficient of x and equality.
questions.prerequisites: Distinguish a reversible operation from one that meets a stated goal.

questions.title: 04 Explain the inverse operation
questions.objective: Choose the inverse that recovers the original equation after division.
questions.prerequisites: Multiply and divide signed numbers; a divisor must be nonzero.

questions.title: 05 Repair the first balance error
questions.objective: Find the first incorrect line and correct the right-hand side.
questions.prerequisites: Follow labelled algebra lines and distinguish a first error from its consequences.

questions.title: 06 Solve a fresh equation
questions.objective: Choose the value that solves the original equation.
questions.prerequisites: Use exact fractions and substitute into a linear equation.
